== LAYOUT SURVEY (from image-001 overview) ==
image-001 is a reduced overview showing two horizontal parchment strips, one above the other (black background). Each strip appears to be a horizontal strip cut from a bifolium: a fold/gutter runs vertically near the middle of each strip, with two text columns on each side of the fold, i.e. four columns per strip (two columns per leaf). Strips are wider than tall; only part of each column's height survives (upper strip ~11-12 lines of text below a blank top margin; lower strip ~20 lines, no margins visible top, bottom edge trimmed).
Upper strip: top margin preserved with ruling. Column 2 has a red rubric heading "Quot(?) multiplex sit fu(tu)r(u)m" (tentative). Above column 4 in the top margin a small brown-ink word (possibly a running title or catchword-like note, "Petrus"? tentative). Paper/parchment label and a metal clip/needle at top centre (mounting). Small red paragraph marks and red-touched capitals in the text; some red underlining in col. 1.
Lower strip: four columns of dense text, red paragraph marks, a display word in larger letters "Actione nec" (?) in column 2 (tentative). Holes and fold damage at gutter.
Script: small Gothic textualis/cursiva-ish university book hand, heavily abbreviated (scholastic text, tentative interpretation). Single text block per column; no visible interlinear gloss on the overview.
